subject: Startups
title: Time to Value
description: A quick win: understand Time to Value.

hook.text: How long does it take a new user to get value from your product? Minutes? Days? Weeks? That gap is everything.

buildup.text: Time to value (TTV) measures the duration from sign-up to first meaningful outcome. Shorter is always better.

discovery.text: Canva gets you designing in under 60 seconds. Salesforce can take months to set up. Radically different TTVs.

twist.text: Every extra step between sign-up and value is a chance for the user to leave. Each click is a mini-exit door.

climax.text: The best products collapse TTV to near-zero. Sign up, get value, come back—all in the first session.

punchline.text: The faster users feel value, the more likely they stay.

quiz.question: What does TTV stand for in startup metrics?
